# 3 B's Tree Removal

> Tree removal, stumps, land clearing and dirt work across Central & Southwest Louisiana: Lake Charles, Sulphur, DeRidder, Leesville, Toledo Bend and up to Alexandria. Storm cleanup also when weather hits. Based in Pitkin, Louisiana. InstaQuote at 3bs.getpros.xyz or call (318) 712-TREE.

3 B's Tree Removal takes on the big, tough jobs for homeowners. The owner, Blake Berry, is a Louisiana licensed arborist for tree work, based in Pitkin, Louisiana. Insured. The business also does skid steer dirt work and land clearing.

The page never books the job. Use the InstaQuote: enter an address, tell them about the job, add photos, and pick a time to call. The team looks over the info and the satellite view, and our team will call you back with a price.

## Services

- Hazardous tree removal: Taking down dangerous or unwanted trees, including work near homes.
- Stump grinding: Grind stumps below grade so the yard can be used again.
- Land clearing and dirt work: Skid steer dirt work, lot and land clearing.
- Professional trimming: Pruning for health, clearance, and a cleaner look around your property.
- Storm cleanup, also when weather hits: Downed limbs, storm-damaged trees, and yard recovery.
- Quote form job types: limb cut, whole tree removal, stump grinding, or not sure.

## How a visit starts

1. Enter your address and pick it from the list, then start the quote.
2. Tell them how many trees, how many stumps, and the job type. A photo of the trees or stumps is optional.
3. Pick a day, a time, and how soon you need it done. Our team will call you back with a price at the time you picked.
